name: Hoodizz
description: E-commerce platforme : using angular and nest js architecture

paragraphs: A full-stack streetwear e-commerce platform — Angular SSR, NestJS GraphQL, Stripe payments.

Hoodizz is a clothing store built end to end: a server-rendered Angular storefront, a typed GraphQL API, Firebase authentication and real Stripe checkout with webhook-driven order status. The whole thing lives in one Nx monorepo.
I designed the UI from scratch with no CSS framework: a bold editorial look (condensed display type, warm paper background, a single hot-orange accent) written in hand-rolled SCSS.
features: Catalog: paginated product listing, category filters, product detail with variant (size/colour) selector
Cart: signal-based store persisted to localStorage
Auth: Firebase email/password and Google sign-in; ID token sent as a Bearer header and verified server-side with firebase-admin
Checkout: Stripe Checkout sessions created by the API, order status updated by a signed webhook
Orders: authenticated order history; the API enforces that users only read their own orders
